transient: Temporary tracker read unavailability, if encountered (not simulated in current issue reads).
permanent: Invalid issue number or issue not found; correct the number or fix the underlying issue data.

transient: Temporary storage read failure, if identified as temporary (not simulated in current search).
permanent: Blank or oversized query, malformed path glob, invalid result limit or response format.
Missing or corrupt search index requires repair; repeating the unchanged call does not fix it.

transient: Temporary storage read failure, if identified as temporary (not simulated in current file reads).
permanent: Missing file, wrong path capitalization, excluded or outside-repository path, non-text file, or invalid response format.

transient: Transport failure known to occur before dispatch, if encountered; no write could have occurred.
permanent: Invalid or missing issue; blank or oversized comment body; invalid arguments.
ambiguous: Timeout after dispatch: the comment may already have committed. Every simulated TrackerTimeout is treated as ambiguous, including one secretly raised before commit.

transient: Transport failure known to occur before dispatch, if encountered; no write could have occurred.
permanent: Invalid or missing issue; incorrect branch; blank or oversized title/body; invalid arguments.
ambiguous: Timeout after dispatch: the PR may already have committed. Every simulated TrackerTimeout is treated as ambiguous, including one secretly raised before commit.
